benchmark_2_sei_rtsa_standard_verificati.system_name: SEI Remote Temperature Sensor (RTSA) & Primary-Backup Switch Failover
verified_findings: Risk R8: Common mode failure risk between Primary and Backup CPUs unless isolated hardware/OS is enforced.
Risk R9: ADC bottleneck and absence of backup data acquisition channel threaten 0.999999 availability SLA.
Sensitivity S3: System availability is highly sensitive to backup data channel presence and heartbeat timeout.
Tradeoff T3: Higher heartbeat frequency (1 sec) improves fault detection time (<= 2s) but increases CPU & communication bus overhead.
Non-Risk N12: Hardware Watchdog timer mechanism is deterministic and proven reliable.
